target_customer: Ecommerce brands that want customer insights without engineers
problem: Brands have customer data scattered across Shopify, ads, email and logistics tools and lack the engineers to build a warehouse and analytics.
product_category: Customer data warehouse and analytics for ecommerce

founders.name: Scott Sonneborn
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page and the Greylock portfolio page.

founders.name: Manav Kohli
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is from Portland, Oregon and is now at Ribbit Capital.

technical_complexity.rationale: A managed data warehouse with connectors to commerce, ads and email tools is standard but integration heavy. A ClickHouse case study describes later fast analytics work.

defensibility.rationale: Once a brand's data is unified, switching has some cost, but connectors and warehouses were available from many vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes an incumbent copying it. The competitor search surfaced only current vendor roundups, so this rating is a judgment from the market structure.

market_need_then: Ecommerce brands needed unified first party data after 2020 growth, but no dated source for demand was found.

branding.domain_note: tydo.com is the company site; the YC slug is polyops, which suggests an earlier name.

brand_strength.rationale: Case studies (Buck Mason, ClickHouse) exist but no community or press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Tydo went through YC Summer 2020 and appears to have kept operating, with databases showing a Greylock backed round in 2022 and a 4.3 million round in January 2025, while YC marks it inactive. The status is unresolved and no shutdown cause is public, so failure factors stay empty. Data conflicts on totals, from 4.94 million to 21 million.
notes: Funding rests on databases: Dealroom 125K seed and 4.94M total; CB Insights seed dated 2022-10 with a 21.16M total; Caplight and geo.sig.ai a 4.32M Series A in Jan 2025. These conflict, so every round rests on a single database. Total unresolved. The YC Inactive label conflicts with Greylock listing it as active and 2025 funding data. Tydo website returned 503 when fetched, so the site check was inconclusive. The company's YC listing name is Tydo with slug polyops; CB Insights URL also uses polyops. Competitor search found no dated 2020 sources, so the list is empty.
